description: This file defines an internal interface IActivationCollector within the Orleans.Runtime namespace. It declares methods for scheduling collection and attempting to reschedule collection of activation data.

classes.name: IActivationCollector
classes.description: An internal interface for managing activation collection scheduling and rescheduling operations.

methods.name: ScheduleCollection
methods.description: Schedules the collection of a specified activation.

methods.name: TryRescheduleCollection
methods.description: Attempts to reschedule the collection of a specified activation.
